answers.explanation: Forwarding is the per-packet action. Routing is the slower work of building the table that forwarding uses.
Backwards. The control plane is software on the routing processor and works in milliseconds. The data plane is the fast hardware path.
The switching fabric connects every input port to every output port.
Routing protocols like OSPF and BGP run on the routing processor. The other three are data plane work done per packet.
That's what keeps forwarding fast: the processor builds the table once and pushes copies down to the ports.
Routing plans ahead. Forwarding is the moment-by-moment decision at each exit.
The data plane, sometimes called the forwarding plane.
Routing and management both run in software on the routing processor.
